Our production locations worldwide

We are a global company with production sites and locations in 16 countries spread across three continents. We produce in the region for the region, around the world. This allows us to be near our customers and the market and to be familiar with international and local regulatory framework conditions. Our large number of production sites also ensures a secure and reliable supply for our customers.
